summary: RunaiModelStreamerLoader now reads the cached safetensors index and restricts the RunAI input file list to shards containing the requested MTP layer plus draft-wide shared MTP parameters. Native DeepSeek and Hugging Face MTP key layouts are supported, including the split between remote object-storage shard URIs and the local metadata cache. Unsafe or unrecognized indexes retain all prepared shards.

tests.what_was_measured: 15 loader tests passed, including regression coverage that observes the exact file list passed to runai_safetensors_weights_iterator for HF and native MTP layouts; object-storage metadata-cache path coverage; shared-parameter inclusion; and fallbacks for missing, malformed, structurally invalid, unknown-layout, requested-layer-absent, and missing-shard indexes. Raw output: reports/j-02c07e9a1b54/pytest-runai-loader.txt
The source, tests, and report contain no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution_evidence: This change performs JSON metadata parsing and filename selection before tensor streaming; it contains no GPU kernel or numerical operation. A GPU smoke or numerical comparison would not measure the requested behavior.
remaining_limitations: No credentials, object-storage endpoint, or large sharded MTP checkpoint were used. The remote-path test uses a real cached index and remote URI-shaped shard paths while mocking only the deterministic metadata-cache lookup.
Shard granularity cannot avoid reading unrelated tensors when a selected shard co-locates them with requested or shared MTP tensors; tensor-level filtering remains downstream of RunAI.
Unknown MTP layer naming layouts intentionally fall back to all shards until explicitly supported.
